claim: effect laundered through a covered call chain (caller's declaration violated; callee's honest)
description: BalanceReport is declared read-only (calor: §E{fs:r}; csharp: doc comment 'read-only ... never writes') but calls AppendEntry — whose own §E{fs:w} declaration is honest — to bump a view-counter file, so the write capability is laundered through the covered call chain BalanceReport → AppendEntry → File.AppendAllText. The violated declaration is the CALLER's; the callee declares its effect truthfully (distinguishing W5-C from W5-A, where the defective function's own declaration is wrong).
coveredPath: bare-name first-order call chain inside one module - EffectEnforcementPass interprocedural SCC propagation; no delegates, no dispatch (the excluded holes are not involved). Cross-module laundering is architecturally identical but blocked by a pre-existing emitter gap (cross-module calls emit unqualified C#) - see the kickoff amendment
calorCatchChannel: build-blocking Calor0410 with the full laundering chain (BalanceReport -> AppendEntry -> File.AppendAllText), fires on the agent's first build
